listeners[event]\r\n  if (!cbs) return\r\n  for (const cb of cbs) cb(data)\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 记录事件序列以验证顺序 */\r\nfunction createEventRecorder(): {\r\n  log: string[]\r\n  record: (label: string) => </text>\r\n        )}\r\n      </svg>\r\n      {/* 图例 */}\r\n      <div className=\"ml-3 flex flex-col gap-1\">\r\n        {slices.map((s, i) => (\r\n          <div key={i} className=\"flex '').toLowerCase()\r\n    const childrenA = getNodeField(a, childrenField) as TreeNodeData[] | undefined\r\n    const childrenB = getNodeField(b, childrenField) as TreeNodeData[] | undefined\r\n    const isDirA = Array.isArray(childrenA)\r\n    const isDirB = Array.isArray(childrenB)\r\n\r\n    if (isDirA !== isDirB) return isDirA ? -1 : 1\r\n\r\n    const cmp = titleA.localeCompare(titleB)\r\n    if (mode === 'name-desc') return -cmp\r\n    return cmp\r\n  })\r\n\r\n  return sorted.map((node) => {\r\n    const children = getNodeField(node, childrenField) as TreeNodeData[] | undefined\r\n    if (!Array.isArray(children) || children.length === 0) return node\r\n    return { ...node, [childrenField]: sortNodes(children, mode, titleField, childrenField) }\r\n  })\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 通用树形组件 支持递归嵌套、展开/折叠动画、状态图标、进度条、 */\r\nexport function FileTreeWidget(rawProps: Record<string, unknown>) {\r\n  const config = extractTreeConfig(rawProps)\r\n  const allData = extractTreeData(rawProps)\r\n\r\n  /** 树标题 */\r\n  const title = config.title ?? rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--floating-quote-text,#fff)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--floating-quote-hover-bg,rgba(255,255,255,0.1))]\"\r\n          title=\"引用到对话 (Enter)\"\r\n        >\r\n          <Quote className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\r\n          <span>引用</span>\r\n        </button>\r\n        <button\r\n          onClick={onClose}\r\n          className=\"flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded text-xs text-[var(--floating-quote-text,#fff)] opacity-60 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100\"\r\n          title=\"关闭 (Esc)\"\r\n          aria-label=\"关闭\"\r\n        >\r\n          ×\r\n        </button>\r\n      </div>\r\n    </div>\r\n  )\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 从文件名提取扩展名 */\r\nfunction extractExtension(fileName: string): string {\r\n  const lastSlash = Math.max(fileName.lastIndexOf('/'), fileName.lastIndexOf('\\\\'))\r\n  const baseName = fileName.substring(lastSlash + 1)\r\n\r\n  if (baseName.startsWith('.') && baseName.lastIndexOf('.') === 0) {\r\n    return baseName.toLowerCase()\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const dotIndex = baseName.lastIndexOf('.')\r\n  if (dotIndex === -1) {\r\n    return baseName.toLowerCase()\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return baseName.substring(dotIndex).toLowerCase()\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 根据文件名获取 Prism 语言标识 */\r\nfunction getLanguage(fileName: string): string {\r\n  const ext = extractExtension(fileName)\r\n  return EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE[ext] ?? 'text'\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 判断文件是否可编辑 */\r\nfunction isEditable(fileName: string): boolean {\r\n  const ext = extractExtension(fileName)\r\n  return EDITABLE_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 代码编辑器组件 功能： */\r\nexport function CodeEditor({\r\n  filePath,\r\n  content: initialContent,\r\n  size,\r\n  onSave,\r\n  readOnly = false,\r\n  className,\r\n  tabId,\r\n  autoRefresh,\r\n}: CodeEditorProps) {\r\n  const [localContent, setLocalContent] = useState(initialContent)\r\n  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false)\r\n  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false)\r\n  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null)\r\n  /** 预览/编辑模式切换，默认预览模式 */\r\n  const [isPreview, setIsPreview] = useState(true)\r\n  /** 外部变更提示状态 */\r\n  const [externalChange, setExternalChange] = useState<{ content: string; size?: number } | null>(null)\r\n  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null)\r\n  const preRef = useRef<HTMLPreElement>(null)\r\n  const isDirtyRef = useRef(isDirty)\r\n\r\n  /** 同步 isDirty 到 ref，供事件监听使用 */\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    isDirtyRef.current = isDirty\r\n  }, [isDirty])\r\n\r\n  const fileName = useMemo(() => {\r\n    const lastSlash = Math.max(filePath.lastIndexOf('/'), filePath.lastIndexOf('\\\\'))\r\n    return filePath.substring(lastSlash + 1)\r\n  }, [filePath])\r\n\r\n  const language = useMemo(() => getLanguage(filePath), [filePath])\r\n  const editable = useMemo(() => !readOnly && isEditable(filePath), [readOnly, filePath])\r\n  const isMarkdownFile = useMemo(() => {\r\n    const ext = extractExtension(filePath)\r\n    return MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)\r\n  }, [filePath])\r\n\r\n  const isLargeFile = useMemo(\r\n    () => (size ?? initialContent.length) > LARGE_FILE_THRESHOLD,\r\n    [size, initialContent.length],\r\n  )\r\n\r\n  /** 内容容器的 ref，用于保存和恢复滚动位置 */\r\n  const contentContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)\r\n\r\n  // ────────────────────────────────────────────\r\n  // 选中引用浮动按钮\r\n  // ────────────────────────────────────────────\r\n  // 用户在预览模式 / 只读模式下选中文字时，弹出「引用」按钮；\r\n  // 点击后把带行号和函数名的格式化文本塞进 Chat 输入框（chatInputStore.requestInsert）。\r\n  // 注意：编辑模式（textarea）使用浏览器原生选择/复制，不挂浮动按钮，避免遮挡编辑光标。\r\n  const requestInsert = useChatInputStore((s) => s.requestInsert)\r\n  const [floatingQuote, setFloatingQuote] = useState<FloatingQuoteState>(FLOATING_QUOTE_INITIAL)\r\n  const justSelectedRef = useRef(false)\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    injectFloatingQuoteStyles()\r\n  }, [])\r\n\r\n  /** 处理预览区文字选中，计算行号范围并弹出浮动按钮 */\r\n  const handlePreviewMouseUp = useCallback(() => {\r\n    const selection = window.getSelection()\r\n    if (!selection || selection.isCollapsed) return\r\n    const selectedText = selection.toString().trim()\r\n    if (!selectedText) return\r\n    const container = contentContainerRef.current\r\n    if (!container) return\r\n    const range = selection.getRangeAt(0)\r\n    const rect = range.getBoundingClientRect()\r\n    const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect()\r\n\r\n    // 1) 优先用 DOM 选区计算行号（适用于 SyntaxHighlighter 多 span 的结构）\r\n    let lineRange: { start: number; end: number } | null = null\r\n    try {\r\n      const preRange = document.createRange()\r\n      preRange.selectNodeContents(container)\r\n      preRange.setEnd(range.startContainer, range.startOffset)\r\n      const textBefore = preRange.toString()\r\n      const startLine = (textBefore.match(/\\n/g) || []).length + 1\r\n      const fullText = textBefore + selectedText\r\n      const endLine = (fullText.match(/\\n/g) || []).length + 1\r\n      lineRange = { start: startLine, end: endLine }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      /* DOM 异常，fallback 到文本匹配 */\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // 2) DOM 选区失败时，用 indexOf 在 localContent 中定位\r\n    if (!lineRange) {\r\n      const sourceIndex = localContent.indexOf(selectedText)\r\n      if (sourceIndex >= 0) {\r\n        const before = localContent.substring(0, sourceIndex)\r\n        const startLine = (before.match(/\\n/g) || []).length + 1\r\n        const including = localContent.substring(0, sourceIndex + selectedText.length)\r\n        const endLine = (including.match(/\\n/g) || []).length + 1\r\n        lineRange = { start: startLine, end: endLine }\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    justSelectedRef.current = true\r\n    setFloatingQuote({\r\n      visible: true,\r\n      selectedText,\r\n      lineRange,\r\n      position: {\r\n        x: rect.left - containerRect.left + rect.width / 2 + container.scrollLeft,\r\n        y: rect.top - containerRect.top - 8 + container.scrollTop,\r\n      },\r\n    })\r\n  }, [localContent])\r\n\r\n  /** 点击预览区空白处关闭浮动按钮（但跳过刚刚的选中事件，避免选中后立即被关闭） */\r\n  const handlePreviewClick = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (justSelectedRef.current) {\r\n      justSelectedRef.current = false\r\n      return\r\n    }\r\n    if (floatingQuote.visible) {\r\n      setFloatingQuote((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))\r\n    }\r\n  }, [floatingQuote.visible])\r\n\r\n  /** 引用选中文字到 Chat 输入框 */\r\n  const handleQuote = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (!floatingQuote.selectedText) return\r\n    const lineRange = floatingQuote.lineRange\r\n    const funcName = lineRange ? detectFunctionName(localContent, lineRange.start) : null\r\n    const lineInfo = lineRange\r\n      ? lineRange.start === lineRange.end\r\n        ? `L${lineRange.start}`\r\n        : `L${lineRange.start}-${lineRange.end}`\r\n      : ''\r\n\r\n    let quotedFileInfo: string\r\n    if (funcName && lineInfo) {\r\n      quotedFileInfo = `${filePath}:${funcName}(${lineInfo})`\r\n    } else if (funcName) {\r\n      quotedFileInfo = `${filePath}:${funcName}`\r\n    } else if (lineInfo) {\r\n      quotedFileInfo = `${filePath}:${lineInfo}`\r\n    } else {\r\n      quotedFileInfo = filePath\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    let formattedQuotedText = floatingQuote.selectedText\r\n    if (lineRange) {\r\n      formattedQuotedText = floatingQuote.selectedText\r\n        .split('\\n')\r\n        .map((line, i) => `L${lineRange.start + i}: ${line}`)\r\n        .join('\\n')\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // 引用文本格式：「${quotedFileInfo}:\\n${quotedText}」\r\n    requestInsert(`「${quotedFileInfo}:\\n${formattedQuotedText}」`)\r\n    setFloatingQuote((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))\r\n    window.getSelection()?.removeAllRanges()\r\n  }, [floatingQuote.selectedText, floatingQuote.lineRange, filePath, localContent, requestInsert])\r\n\r\n  /** Esc 关闭浮动按钮 */\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    if (!floatingQuote.visible) return\r\n    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {\r\n      if (e.key === 'Escape') {\r\n        setFloatingQuote((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', handler)\r\n    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handler)\r\n  }, [floatingQuote.visible])\r\n\r\n  /** 当切换文件时重置浮动按钮 */\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    setFloatingQuote(FLOATING_QUOTE_INITIAL)\r\n  }, [filePath])\r\n\r\n  /** 当外部 content 变化时同步（如文件重新加载） */\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    setLocalContent(initialContent)\r\n    setIsDirty(false)\r\n    setSaveError(null)\r\n    setExternalChange(null)\r\n  }, [initialContent])\r\n\r\n  /** 保存当前滚动位置 */\r\n  const saveScrollPosition = useCallback(() => {\r\n    const container = contentContainerRef.current\r\n    if (!container) return null\r\n    return {\r\n      scrollTop: container.scrollTop,\r\n      scrollLeft: container.scrollLeft,\r\n    }\r\n  }, [])\r\n\r\n  /** 恢复滚动位置 */\r\n  const restoreScrollPosition = useCallback((pos: { scrollTop: number; scrollLeft: number } | null) => {\r\n    if (!pos) return\r\n    const container = contentContainerRef.current\r\n    if (!container) return\r\n    requestAnimationFrame(() => {\r\n      container.scrollTop = pos.scrollTop\r\n      container.scrollLeft = pos.scrollLeft\r\n    })\r\n  }, [])\r\n\r\n  /** 订阅文件外部变更事件 当文件被外部修改时，如果当前没有未保存的修改，自动同步新内容； */\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    if (!tabId) return\r\n\r\n    const handleFileChange = (newContent: string, newSize?: number) => {\r\n      if (isDirtyRef.current) {\r\n        // 有未保存修改，显示覆盖提示\r\n        setExternalChange({ content: newContent, size: newSize })\r\n      } else {\r\n        // 无未保存修改，直接同步，保持滚动位置\r\n        const scrollPos = saveScrollPosition()\r\n        setLocalContent(newContent)\r\n        setIsDirty(false)\r\n        setSaveError(null)\r\n        restoreScrollPosition(scrollPos)\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    subscribeFileChange(tabId, handleFileChange)\r\n    return () => unsubscribeFileChange(tabId, handleFileChange)\r\n  }, [tabId, saveScrollPosition, restoreScrollPosition])\r\n\r\n  /** 处理外部变更覆盖 用户确认用外部修改覆盖当前未保存的内容。 */\r\n  const handleAcceptExternalChange = useCallback(() => {\r\n    if (externalChange) {\r\n      const scrollPos = saveScrollPosition()\r\n      setLocalContent(externalChange.content)\r\n      setIsDirty(false)\r\n      setSaveError(null)\r\n      setExternalChange(null)\r\n      restoreScrollPosition(scrollPos)\r\n    }\r\n  }, [externalChange, saveScrollPosition, restoreScrollPosition])\r\n\r\n  /** 忽略外部变更 用户选择保留当前修改，忽略外部变更。 */\r\n  const handleIgnoreExternalChange = useCallback(() => {\r\n    setExternalChange(null)\r\n  }, [])\r\n\r\n  /** 处理保存 */\r\n  const handleSave = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    if (!isDirty || isSaving)     setSaveError('保存失败')\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      setSaveError('保存失败，请重试')\r\n    } finally {\r\n      setIsSaving(false)\r\n    }\r\n  }, [isDirty, isSaving, localContent, onSave])\r\n\r\n  /** Ctrl+S 快捷键 */\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {\r\n      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 's') {\r\n        e.preventDefault()\r\n        if (editable && isDirty && !isSaving) {\r\n          handleSave()\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)\r\n    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)\r\n  }, [editable, isDirty, isSaving, handleSave])\r\n\r\n  /** 同步 textarea 滚动位置到 pre 高亮层 */\r\n  const handleScroll = useCallback(() => {\r\n    const textarea = textareaRef.current\r\n    const pre = preRef.current\r\n    if (textarea && pre) {\r\n      pre.scrollTop = textarea.scrollTop\r\n      pre.scrollLeft = textarea.scrollLeft\r\n    }\r\n  }, [])\r\n\r\n  /** 处理文本变更 */\r\n  const handleChange = useCallback(\r\n    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {\r\n      if (!editable) return\r\n      const newContent = e.target.value\r\n      setLocalContent(newContent)\r\n      setIsDirty(newContent !== initialContent)\r\n      setSaveError(null)\r\n    },\r\n    [editable, initialContent],\r\n  )\r\n\r\n  // 大文件提示\r\n  if (isLargeFile && editable) {\r\n    return (\r\n      <div className={cn('flex h-full flex-col', className)}>\r\n        <div className=\"border-border bg-muted/30 flex items-center gap-2 border-b px-4 py-2\">\r\n          <FileText className=\"text-muted-foreground h-4 w-4\" />\r\n          <span className=\"text-foreground text-sm font-medium\">{fileName}</span>\r\n          <span className=\"text-muted-foreground ml-2 text-xs\">\r\n            ({((size ?? initialContent.length) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)\r\n          </span>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div className=\"flex flex-1 items-center justify-center p-8\">\r\n          <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n            <AlertTriangle className=\"mx-auto mb-3 h-10 w-10 text-amber-500\" />\r\n            <p className=\"text-foreground mb-1 text-sm font-medium\">文件过大，无法编辑</p>\r\n            <p className=\"text-muted-foreground text-xs\">\r\n              文件大小超过 1MB（当前 {(size ?? initialContent.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB），\r\n              为保证编辑性能，请使用本地编辑器修改。\r\n            </p>\r\n          </div>\r\n        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n    )\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // 不可编辑文件：始终使用只读预览模式，不显示切换按钮\r\n  if (!editable) {\r\n    return (\r\n      <div className={cn('flex h-full flex-col', className)}>\r\n        <div className=\"border-border bg-muted/30 flex items-center gap-2 border-b px-4 py-2\">\r\n          <FileText className=\"text-muted-foreground h-4 w-4\" />\r\n          <span className=\"text-foreground text-sm font-medium\">{fileName}</span>\r\n          <span className=\"text-muted-foreground ml-2 text-xs\">（只读预览）</span>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div\r\n          ref={contentContainerRef}\r\n          className=\"relative min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-auto\"\r\n          onMouseUp={handlePreviewMouseUp}\r\n          onClick={handlePreviewClick}\r\n        >\r\n          <SyntaxHighlighter\r\n            language={language}\r\n            style={oneDark}\r\n            showLineNumbers={true}\r\n            wrapLongLines={true}\r\n            lineProps={HIGHLIGHTER_LINE_PROPS}\r\n            customStyle={{\r\n              margin: 0,\r\n              borderRadius: 0,\r\n              fontSize: '0.8125rem',\r\n              background: 'var(--code-bg, #1e1e1e)',\r\n              minHeight: '100%',\r\n            }}\r\n            codeTagProps={{\r\n              style: {\r\n                fontFamily:\r\n                  'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, \"SF Mono\", Menlo, Consolas, monospace',\r\n              },\r\n            }}\r\n          >\r\n            {localContent}\r\n          </SyntaxHighlighter>\r\n          {floatingQuote.visible && (\r\n            <FloatingQuoteButton\r\n              position={floatingQuote.position}\r\n              onQuote={handleQuote}\r\n              onClose={() => setFloatingQuote((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))}\r\n            />\r\n          )}\r\n        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n    )\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // 可编辑文件：支持预览/编辑模式切换\r\n  return (\r\n    <div className={cn('flex h-full flex-col', className)}>\r\n      {/* 外部变更提示条 */}\r\n      {externalChange && (\r\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between border-b border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 px-4 py-2\">\r\n          <div className=\"flex items-center </div>\r\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n            <button\r\n              onClick={handleAcceptExternalChange}\r\n              className=\"flex items-center gap-1 className=\"h-3 w-3\" />\r\n              覆盖\r\n            </button>\r\n            <button\r\n              onClick={handleIgnoreExternalChange}\r\n              className=\"flex items-center gap-1 忽略\r\n            </button>\r\n          </div>\r\n        </div>\r\n      )}\r\n\r\n      {/* 工具栏 */}\r\n      <div className=\"border-border bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2\">\r\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n          <FileText className=\"text-muted-foreground h-4 w-4\" />\r\n          <span className=\"text-foreground text-sm font-medium\">\r\n            {fileName}\r\n            {!isPreview && isDirty && <span className=\"text-amber-500 ml-0.5\">*</span>}\r\n          </span>\r\n          <span className=\"text-muted-foreground text-xs lowercase\">{language}</span>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n          {saveError && (\r\n            <span className=\"text-destructive text-xs\">{saveError}</span>\r\n          )}\r\n          {/* 编辑模式下显示保存按钮 */}\r\n          {!isPreview && (\r\n            <button\r\n              onClick={handleSave}\r\n              disabled={!isDirty || isSaving}\r\n              className={cn(\r\n                'flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90'\r\n                  : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground cursor-not-allowed',\r\n              )}\r\n              title=\"保存 (Ctrl+S)\"\r\n            >\r\n              <Save className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\r\n              {isSaving ? '保存中...' : '保存'}\r\n            </button>\r\n          )}\r\n          {/* 预览/编辑切换按钮 */}\r\n          <button\r\n            onClick={() => setIsPreview((prev) => !prev)}\r\n            className={cn(\r\n              'flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors',\r\n              !isPreview\r\n                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700'\r\n                : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground',\r\n            )}\r\n            title={isPreview ? '切换到编辑模式' : '切换到预览模式'}\r\n          >\r\n            {!isPreview ? (\r\n              <>\r\n                <Eye className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\r\n                <span>查看</span>\r\n              </>\r\n            ) : (\r\n              <>\r\n                <Pencil className=\"h-3.5 w-3.5\" />\r\n                <span>编辑</span>\r\n              </>\r\n            )}\r\n          </button>\r\n        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* 内容区域：根据模式切换渲染 */}\r\n      {isPreview ? (\r\n        /* 预览模式：Markdown 文件使用 LobeChatMarkdown 渲染，其他使用 SyntaxHighlighter */\r\n        isMarkdownFile ? onMouseUp={handlePreviewMouseUp}\r\n            onClick={handlePreviewClick}\r\n          >\r\n            <LobeChatMarkdown content={localContent} />\r\n            {floatingQuote.visible && (\r\n              <FloatingQuoteButton\r\n                position={floatingQuote.position}\r\n                onQuote={handleQuote}\r\n                onClose={() => setFloatingQuote((prev) => ({ ...prev, language={language}\r\n              style={oneDark}\r\n              showLineNumbers={true}\r\n              wrapLongLines={true}\r\n              lineProps={HIGHLIGHTER_LINE_PROPS}\r\n              customStyle={{\r\n                margin: 0,\r\n                borderRadius: 0,\r\n                fontSize: '0.8125rem',\r\n                background: 'var(--code-bg, #1e1e1e)',\r\n  </div>\r\n    )\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  if (!devBypass && !isAuthenticated) {\r\n    return <Navigate to={ROUTES.LOGIN} replace />\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <>\r\n      {children}\r\n      {/* 初始化全局流式事件处理器（不随组件卸载而销毁）\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    initStreamingEvents()\r\n    return () => {\r\n      destroyStreamingEvents()\r\n    }\r\n  }, [])\r\n\r\n  // 响应式订阅 token：登录/登出/token 刷新时自动（重）连 WS。\r\n  // 原实现用 getState().token 快照 + 空依赖数组，只在组件挂载时执行一次——\r\n  // 未登录进入页面时 token 为 null 不连接，登录成功后 token 更新但 effect 不重跑，\r\n  // 导致 WS 永远不连（\"启动后一直未连接、发送卡住\"根因）。\r\n  // 各类 App 记录登录状态的通用模式：持久化凭证恢复 → 设置响应式状态 → 依赖它的逻辑\r\n  // 自动响应。这里订阅 token 变化，登录后 effect 自动重跑建立 WS 连接。\r\n  const authToken = useAuthStore((s) => s.token)\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    if (authToken) {\r\n = useCallback(\r\n    async (sessionId: string) => {\r\n      // 保存当前会话的 Tab 状态到 localStorage\r\n      useAgentTabStore.getState().saveCurrentTabs()\r\n\r\n      await setActiveSession(sessionId)\r\n      const currentToken = useAuthStore.getState().token\r\n      if (currentToken) {\r\n        connectWebSocket(sessionId, currentToken)\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      // 移动端选择会话后自动收起侧边栏\r\n      if useCallback(\r\n    async (params: SendMessageParams) => {\r\n      const { activeSessionId: sid } = useSessionStore.getState()\r\n      const currentToken = useAuthStore.getState().token\r\n\r\n ').trim().slice(0, 30)\r\n        if (title) {\r\n          listStore.renameSession(sid, title)\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      const pipelineStore = usePipelineMessageStore.getState()\r\n\r\n '[handleSendMessage] pipelineId 不一致，用会话真实值: sid=%s param=%s real=%s',\r\n          sid.slice(0, 12),\r\n          params.pipelineId.slice(0, 12),\r\n          targetPipelineId.slice(0, 12),\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      const userMessageId = generateUUID()\r\n      const userMessage: Message = {\r\n        id: userMessageId,\r\n        sessionId: sid,\r\n        role: 'user',\r\n        content: params.content,\r\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\r\n        sequence: allocateNextSequence(targetPipelineId),\r\n        status: 'completed',\r\n        clientMessageId:     url: att.url || '',\r\n        })),\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      pipelineStore.addMessage(targetPipelineId, userMessage)\r\n      const enteredInteraction =\r\n '::' + m.timestamp + '::' + contentPrefix\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * 判断本地消息是否被 API 权威消息覆盖（即二者是同一条逻辑消息）。\r\n *\r\n * 去重规则唯一真相源，全量对账（initFromAPI）与增量补漏（append/prepend）共用：\r\n * - id 相同 → 同一条（后端 record_id == WS message_id，正常路径）\r\n * - clientMessageId 相同 → 同一条（user 乐观版 id=前端 UUID，API 版 id=后端\r\n *   record_id，id 不同但后端从乐观消息回传了相同 clientMessageId）\r\n *\r\n * 命中时本地版让位 API 版（丢弃本地、保留 API），保证全量与增量两条路径的\r\n * 渲染终态一致 —— 切会话回来（增量）与刷新（全量）不会产生不同的消息列表。\r\n */\r\nfunction isCoveredByApi(m: Message, apiIds: Set<string>, apiByClientId: Map<string, Message>): boolean {\r\n  if (apiIds.has(m.id)) return true\r\n  if (m.clientMessageId && apiByClientId.has(m.clientMessageId)) return true\r\n  return false\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 合并 API 权威消息与本地已有消息 策略： */\r\nfunction mergeApiWithExisting(\r\n  sorted: Message[],\r\n  existing: Message[] | undefined,\r\n): { finalMessages: Message[]; preservedCount: number } {\r\n  if (!existing || existing.length === 0) {\r\n    return { finalMessages: sorted, preservedCount: 0 }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const apiIds = new Set(sorted.map((m) => m.id))\r\n  const apiByClientId = new Map<string, Message>()\r\n  for (const m of sorted) {\r\n    if (m.clientMessageId) {\r\n      apiByClientId.set(m.clientMessageId, m)\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // 本地独有的消息（API 没有的）保留策略：\r\n  // 1. 正在 streaming 的占位消息 — 必须保留（等 stream_end/new_message 收尾）\r\n  // 2. 刚发送的乐观 user 消息（30s 窗口内，带 clientMessageId） — 保留（后端可能尚未持久化）\r\n  // 3. 其余本地消息 — 丢弃，以 API 权威数据为准。\r\n  const localOnly = existing.filter((m) => {\r\n    if (isCoveredByApi(m, apiIds, apiByClientId)) return false\r\n    // 系统通知是 AI 消息之间的结构分隔符，必须保留：\r\n    // 后端 system_notification 是瞬态事件，通常不在消息历史 API 中返回，\r\n    // 若丢弃则刷新/切 Tab 后它消失，前后的 AI 气泡失去边界被合并成一条。\r\n    if (m.role === 'system') return true\r\n    // 正在 streaming 的占位消息必须保留\r\n    if (isStreamingMessage(m)) return true\r\n    // 乐观/刚完成的消息在持久化窗口内保留（后端可能尚未写入）\r\n    if (isWithinOptimisticGrace(m)) return true\r\n    // 其余本地消息：API 没有就以 API 为准丢弃\r\n    return false\r\n  })\r\n\r\n  if (localOnly.length === 0) {\r\n    return { finalMessages: sorted, preservedCount: 0 }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // localOnly 保留的消息若与 API 同 role::seq 指纹，视为同一条逻辑消息，\r\n  // 从 sorted 移除 API 重复项，保留 localOnly 版本（流式占位符 / 乐观版本）。\r\n  // // streaming 占位符与 API 权威消息 id 不同（WS UUID vs API hex），靠 role::seq\r\n  // 指纹识别为同一条，避免切换 Tab 时 AI 气泡重复渲染。\r\n  // // 宽限期保留的 completed assistant 消息同理——后端已持久化时 API 会返回同 seq\r\n  // 权威版本，此时去重只留一份，避免「保留乐观版 + API 版」并存成两条。\r\n  // 后端未持久化时 API 不含该指纹，localOnly 版本正常保留，等待下次 fetch 对账。\r\n  const localOnlyFingerprints = new Set(localOnly.map((m) => makeMessageFingerprint(m)))\r\n  const dedupedSorted = localOnlyFingerprints.size\r\n    ? sorted.filter((m) => !localOnlyFingerprints.has(makeMessageFingerprint(m)))\r\n    : sorted\r\n\r\n  // 注意：mergeSorted 要求两个输入各自升序，localOnly 来自 existing（可能无序，\r\n  // 如 persist 恢复或并发写入），需先排序。\r\n  const sortedLocalOnly = [...localOnly].sort(compareMessages)\r\n  return { finalMessages: mergeSorted(dedupedSorted, sortedLocalOnly), preservedCount: localOnly.length }\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * 增量补漏（append/prepend）合并：API 仅返回新增消息（after_sequence 增量或\r\n * before_sequence 翻页），本地已有历史必须全部保留 —— 与 initFromAPI 的全量对账\r\n * 不同（全量会丢弃 API 没返回的旧消息，增量必须保留 ≤ bottomCursor 的历史）。\r\n *\r\n * 去重规则与全量路径共用 isCoveredByApi：本地消息若被 API 覆盖（同 id 或同\r\n * clientMessageId），让位 API 版，保证增量与全量渲染终态一致。user 乐观版\r\n * （id=前端 UUID）与 API 版（id=后端 record_id）同 clientMessageId 时不会并存。\r\n *\r\n * 仅做合并 + 去重，后处理（流式合并 / 空气泡过滤 / 内存封顶）由调用方按需追加。\r\n */\r\nfunction mergeIncrementalApiWithLocal(apiSorted: Message[], existing: Message[]): Message[] {\r\n  if (apiSorted.length === 0) return existing\r\n  if (existing.length === 0) return apiSorted\r\n\r\n  const apiIds = new Set(apiSorted.map((m) => m.id))\r\n  const apiByClientId = new Map<string, Message>()\r\n  for (const m of apiSorted) {\r\n    if (m.clientMessageId) apiByClientId.set(m.clientMessageId, m)\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // 本地消息：被 API 覆盖 → 让位 API 版（丢弃本地乐观版）；其余全部保留（增量语义）。\r\n  const keptLocal = existing.filter((m) => !isCoveredByApi(m, apiIds, apiByClientId))\r\n\r\n  // mergeSorted 要求两边各自升序；keptLocal 来自 existing（可能无序），先排序。\r\n  return mergeSorted([...keptLocal].sort(compareMessages), apiSorted)\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** 计算 bottom 游标（只增不减，防止流式消息 sequence 临时值导致回退） 取 max(API 返回的最大 seq, 现有 bottomCursor)，只增不减。 */\r\nfunction calculateBottomCursor(finalMessages: Message[], existingCursor: number | undefined): number {\r\n  const apiBottomCursor = finalMessages.length > 0\r\n    ? finalMessages.reduce((max, m) => Math.max(max, m.sequence ?? 0), 0)\r\n    : 0\r\n  return Math.max(apiBottomCursor, existingCursor ?? 0)\r\n}\r\n\r\n\r\n/** 统一管道消息 Store */\r\nexport const usePipelineMessageStore = create<PipelineMessageState>()(\r\n  persist((set, get) => ({\r\n  messagesByPipeline: {},\r\n  pipelines: {},\r\n  pipelineSessionMap: {},\r\n  streamingState: {},\r\n  activePipelineId: null,\r\n  topCursorsByPipeline: {},\r\n  bottomCursorsByPipeline: {},\r\n  hasMoreOlderByPipeline: {},\r\n  isLoadingOlderByPipeline: {},\r\n  reconciledByPipeline: {},\r\n\r\n  /** 注册管道，建立 pipelineId 与元数据的映射 */\r\n  registerPipeline: (meta: PipelineMeta) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      const existingMeta = state.pipelines[meta.pipelineId]\r\n      // 如果已存在相同 pipelineId，保留已有消息和未读计数\r\n      return {\r\n        pipelines: {\r\n          ...state.pipelines,\r\n          [meta.pipelineId]: existingMeta\r\n            ? { ...existingMeta, ...meta, unreadCount: existingMeta.unreadCount }\r\n            : meta,\r\n        },\r\n        pipelineSessionMap: {\r\n          ...state.pipelineSessionMap,\r\n          [meta.pipelineId]: meta.sessionId,\r\n        },\r\n        messagesByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.messagesByPipeline,\r\n          [meta.pipelineId]: state.messagesByPipeline[meta.pipelineId] || [],\r\n        },\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 激活管道，同时重置该管道的未读计数 */\r\n  activatePipeline: (pipelineId: string) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      const meta = state.pipelines[pipelineId]\r\n      return {\r\n        activePipelineId: pipelineId,\r\n        pipelines: meta\r\n          ? {\r\n              ...state.pipelines,\r\n              [pipelineId]: { ...meta, unreadCount: 0 },\r\n            }\r\n          : state.pipelines,\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 添加消息到指定管道，自动去重和排序 */\r\n  addMessage: (pipelineId: string, message: Message) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      const pipelineMessages = state.messagesByPipeline[pipelineId] || []\r\n      const realMessageId = (message as Message & { message_id?: string }).message_id || message.id\r\n\r\n      const existingIndex = pipelineMessages.findIndex((m) => m.id === realMessageId)\r\n\r\n      let updatedMessages: Message[]\r\n      let unreadChanged = false\r\n\r\n      if (existingIndex >= 0) {\r\n        updatedMessages = [...pipelineMessages]\r\n        updatedMessages[existingIndex] = {\r\n          ...pipelineMessages[existingIndex],\r\n          ...message,\r\n          id: pipelineMessages[existingIndex].id,\r\n        }\r\n      } else {\r\n        updatedMessages = [...pipelineMessages, { ...message, id: realMessageId }]\r\n        if (state.activePipelineId !== pipelineId) {\r\n          unreadChanged = true\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      const newPipelines = { ...state.pipelines }\r\n      if (unreadChanged && newPipelines[pipelineId]) {\r\n        newPipelines[pipelineId] = {\r\n          ...newPipelines[pipelineId],\r\n          unreadCount: newPipelines[pipelineId].unreadCount + 1,\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      // bottomCursor 只由 API 权威路径（initFromAPI / appendMessages / prependMessages）维护。\r\n      // addMessage 是乐观/流式/通知消息的入口（router 乐观 user、ensureStreamingPlaceholder\r\n      // 流式占位、handleSystemNotification 系统通知），其 sequence 来自本地分配\r\n      // （allocateNextSequence 可能用 Math.max(localMax+1) 抬升），并非后端权威值。\r\n      // 若让它推进 bottomCursor，会污染双游标：\r\n      //   - 系统通知 sequence 被抬到 localMax+1，initFromAPI 重排时被 mergeSorted 排到末尾，\r\n      //     导致「通知跑到 AI 回复后面」（排序错乱）。\r\n      //   - 流式占位的临时 sequence 进入游标，下次 after_sequence=bottomCursor 补漏会跳过\r\n      //     真正未加载的权威消息。\r\n      // 流式期间 bottomCursor 保持不动，等流式结束 → 切 Tab/重连触发 appendMessages 时\r\n      // 由 calculateBottomCursor 写入权威值。\r\n\r\n      return {\r\n        messagesByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.messagesByPipeline,\r\n          // 内存封顶：超量时丢弃最老消息，防止长会话撑爆内存（OOM）\r\n          [pipelineId]: capMessagesForMemory(updatedMessages),\r\n        },\r\n        pipelines: newPipelines,\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 更新指定管道中的消息（部分更新），支持模糊匹配 注意：找不到消息时不会自动创建，仅输出 warn 日志。 */\r\n  updateMessage: (pipelineId: string, messageId: string, partial: Partial<Message>) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      const pipelineMessages = state.messagesByPipeline[pipelineId] || []\r\n\r\n      let messageIndex = pipelineMessages.findIndex((m) => m.id === messageId)\r\n\r\n      // 精确匹配失败时，assistant 消息尝试基于 sequence 模糊匹配\r\n      if (messageIndex < 0 && partial.role === 'assistant' && partial.sequence != null) {\r\n        messageIndex = pipelineMessages.findIndex((m) =>\r\n          m.role === 'assistant' && m.sequence === partial.sequence,\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      if (messageIndex < 0) {\r\n        if (partial.sequence != null) {\r\n          const fingerprint = (partial.role || 'assistant') + '::seq::' + partial.sequence\r\n          messageIndex = pipelineMessages.findIndex((m) => makeMessageFingerprint(m) === fingerprint)\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      if (messageIndex < 0) {\r\n        logger.error(\r\n          '[updateMessage] 目标消息不存在，跳过更新（不创建避免重复）: pipelineId=%s messageId=%s role=%s seq=%s',\r\n          pipelineId?.slice(0, 12),\r\n          messageId?.slice(0, 12),\r\n          partial.role ?? 'unknown',\r\n          partial.sequence ?? 'unknown',\r\n        )\r\n        return state\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      const updatedMessages = [...pipelineMessages]\r\n      updatedMessages[messageIndex] = {\r\n        ...updatedMessages[messageIndex],\r\n        ...partial,\r\n        _lastUpdated: Date.now(),\r\n      } as Message\r\n\r\n      return {\r\n        messagesByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.messagesByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: updatedMessages,\r\n        },\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 获取指定管道的消息列表 */\r\n  getMessages: (pipelineId: string) => {\r\n    return get().messagesByPipeline[pipelineId] || []\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 移除指定管道中的消息 */\r\n  removeMessage: (pipelineId: string, messageId: string) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      const pipelineMessages = state.messagesByPipeline[pipelineId] || []\r\n      const messageIndex = pipelineMessages.findIndex((m) => m.id === messageId)\r\n      if (messageIndex < 0) return state\r\n      const updatedMessages = pipelineMessages.filter((_, i) => i !== messageIndex)\r\n      return {\r\n        messagesByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.messagesByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: updatedMessages,\r\n        },\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 开始流式传输，记录正在流式传输的消息 ID */\r\n  startStreaming: (pipelineId: string, messageId: string) => {\r\n    set((state) => ({\r\n      streamingState: {\r\n        ...state.streamingState,\r\n        [pipelineId]: {\r\n          isStreaming: true,\r\n          messageId,\r\n          startedAt: Date.now(),\r\n        },\r\n      },\r\n    }))\r\n    // 同步 context key：有任意管道运行中 → pipeline.running=true（ADR §3.4）\r\n    useContextKeys.getState().setPipelineRunning(true)\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 停止流式传输，同时将消息状态标记为 completed */\r\n  stopStreaming: (pipelineId: string) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      const streamStatus = state.streamingState[pipelineId]\r\n      const newStreamingState = { ...state.streamingState }\r\n      delete newStreamingState[pipelineId]\r\n\r\n      if (streamStatus?.messageId) {\r\n        const pipelineMessages = state.messagesByPipeline[pipelineId] || []\r\n        const messageIndex = pipelineMessages.findIndex(\r\n          (m) => m.id === streamStatus.messageId,\r\n        )\r\n\r\n        if (messageIndex >= 0) {\r\n          const updatedMessages = [...pipelineMessages]\r\n          const stoppedMsg = updatedMessages[messageIndex]\r\n          // 收尾 part 状态：仅设置 message.status='completed' 会让 isStreamingMessage\r\n          // 仍因残留的 'streaming'/'calling' part 返回 true（数据不一致，Stop 后再发新\r\n          // 消息会卡在\"思考中\"）。与 handleStreamError 对齐：\r\n          //   text/thinking 'streaming' -> 'done'\r\n          //   tool_call 'calling'/'streaming' -> 'error'（abort 后未返回的工具调用视为失败）\r\n          const finalizedParts = (stoppedMsg.parts || []).map((p) => {\r\n            const partState = (p as { state?: string }).state\r\n            if ((p.type === 'text' || p.type === 'thinking') && partState === 'streaming') {\r\n              return { ...p, state: 'done' as const } as MessagePart\r\n            }\r\n            if (p.type === 'tool_call' && (partState === 'calling' || partState === 'streaming')) {\r\n              return { ...p, state: 'error' as const } as MessagePart\r\n            }\r\n            return p\r\n          })\r\n          updatedMessages[messageIndex] = {\r\n            ...stoppedMsg,\r\n            parts: finalizedParts,\r\n            status: 'completed',\r\n            _lastUpdated: Date.now(),\r\n          }\r\n\r\n          return {\r\n            streamingState: newStreamingState,\r\n            messagesByPipeline: {\r\n              ...state.messagesByPipeline,\r\n              [pipelineId]: updatedMessages,\r\n            },\r\n          }\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      return {\r\n        streamingState: newStreamingState,\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n    // 同步 context key：无管道运行中时回 idle（ADR §3.4）\r\n    const stillRunning = Object.keys(get().streamingState).length > 0\r\n    useContextKeys.getState().setPipelineRunning(stillRunning)\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 查询指定管道是否正在流式传输 */\r\n  isStreaming: (pipelineId: string) => {\r\n    return get().streamingState[pipelineId]?.isStreaming ?? false\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 冷启动：从 API 写入最新消息并设置双游标 FIX: 合并策略 — streaming 消息仅在 API 未返回同 ID 时保留，其余以 API 数据为准。 */\r\n  initFromAPI: (pipelineId: string, messages: Message[], hasMoreOlder?: boolean) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      const sorted = [...messages].sort(compareMessages)\r\n      const existing = state.messagesByPipeline[pipelineId]\r\n\r\n      logger.info('[initFromAPI] pipelineId=%s apiMsgs=%d existingMsgs=%d',\r\n        pipelineId?.slice(0, 12), sorted.length, existing?.length || 0)\r\n\r\n      // ★ 刷新语义：完全丢弃本地消息，只用 API 权威数据。\r\n      // 不保留任何 localOnly（不合并、不宽限、不 streaming 保护）——\r\n      // 刷新后所有内容都从后端持久化拿，本地流式缓存一律丢弃。\r\n      // 后端正在输出时，WS 重连的 backfill 增量补漏 + 续流会补回新内容。\r\n      let finalMessages = sorted\r\n      // 过滤空白 assistant 消息（无 content 无 parts），避免空气泡\r\n      finalMessages = filterBlankMessages(finalMessages)\r\n      // 内存封顶：超量时丢弃最老消息，防止长会话撑爆内存（OOM）\r\n      finalMessages = capMessagesForMemory(finalMessages)\r\n\r\n      const topCursor = finalMessages.length > 0 ? (finalMessages[0].sequence ?? 0) : 0\r\n      const bottomCursor = calculateBottomCursor(finalMessages, state.bottomCursorsByPipeline[pipelineId])\r\n\r\n      logger.info('[initFromAPI] done: pipelineId=%s finalMsgs=%d (全量替换，不保留本地)',\r\n        pipelineId?.slice(0, 12), finalMessages.length)\r\n\r\n      return {\r\n        messagesByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.messagesByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: finalMessages,\r\n        },\r\n        topCursorsByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.topCursorsByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: topCursor,\r\n        },\r\n        bottomCursorsByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.bottomCursorsByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: bottomCursor,\r\n        },\r\n        hasMoreOlderByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.hasMoreOlderByPipeline,\r\n          // 后端始终返回 has_more，前端直接使用\r\n          [pipelineId]: hasMoreOlder ?? false,\r\n        },\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 向上翻页：将更早消息插入头部并更新 topCursor */\r\n  prependMessages: (pipelineId: string, messages: Message[], hasMoreOlder?: boolean) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      if (messages.length === 0) {\r\n        return {\r\n          hasMoreOlderByPipeline: {\r\n            ...state.hasMoreOlderByPipeline,\r\n            [pipelineId]: false,\r\n          },\r\n          isLoadingOlderByPipeline: {\r\n            ...state.isLoadingOlderByPipeline,\r\n            [pipelineId]: false,\r\n          },\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n      const sorted = [...messages].sort(compareMessages)\r\n      const existing = state.messagesByPipeline[pipelineId] || []\r\n      // 合并新旧消息（保留已有 + 去重新增），不做 mergePreservingStreaming 二次合并——\r\n      // 它内部的 mergeConsecutiveAssistantMessages 会把跨页边界的连续 assistant\r\n      // 合并成一条，子管道（全是连续 tool 调用）50+50=100 条会被合并成 1-2 条，\r\n      // 导致向上加载后消息几乎全丢。连续 assistant 的气泡合并由渲染层负责，\r\n      // 数据层保持原始消息、sequence 连续。\r\n      const merged = mergeIncrementalApiWithLocal(sorted, existing)\r\n      // 过滤空白 assistant 消息（无 content 无 parts 无 toolCalls），避免空气泡\r\n      let finalMerged = filterBlankMessages(merged)\r\n      const topCursor = finalMerged[0]?.sequence ?? 0\r\n      return {\r\n        messagesByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.messagesByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: finalMerged,\r\n        },\r\n        topCursorsByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.topCursorsByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: topCursor,\r\n        },\r\n        hasMoreOlderByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.hasMoreOlderByPipeline,\r\n          // 后端始终返回 has_more，前端直接使用\r\n          [pipelineId]: hasMoreOlder ?? false,\r\n        },\r\n        isLoadingOlderByPipeline: {\r\n          ...state.isLoadingOlderByPipeline,\r\n          [pipelineId]: false,\r\n        },\r\n      }\r\n    })\r\n  },\r\n\r\n  /** 断线补漏：追加缺失消息到底部并更新 bottomCursor */\r\n  appendMessages: (pipelineId: string, messages: Message[]) => {\r\n    set((state) => {\r\n      if
